'''Tobias''' (Japanese: '''アーシア島の長老''' ''{{tt|Earthia|Shamouti}} Island Elder'') is a minor character who appeared in ''[[M02|The Power of One]]''. He is a [[Shamouti Island]] community elder.

==History==
[[File:OI Tobias costume.png|thumb|200px|left|Tobias in his festival costume]]
Tobias was the one who informed {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} of the ancient prophecy regarding the [[legendary birds]] and the guardian of the seas, {{p|Lugia}}. Like [[Carol]] and {{OBP|Melody|M02}}, he doesn't take the island tradition too seriously. He even whispers to Ash that the costumed spectacular is a tourist gimmick.

Tobias and Carol stayed on Shamouti while Ash and [[Maren]], and eventually {{an|Misty}}, {{Tracey}}, and Melody, set out to collect the three orbs of {{t|Fire}}, {{t|Ice}}, and {{t|Electric|Lightning}} to fulfill the prophecy.

Tobias was last seen with Carol and the other residents, waving goodbye to Maren and her passengers.

Tobias briefly reappeared in a montage in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'', which chronicled the preceding nine {{pkmn|movie}}s.

==Trivia==
* This character's name is not mentioned in either the original Japanese or the English dub. However, varying sources, such as the [[Pokémon the Movie 2000 Trading Cards]] released by [[Topps]] and the subtitles on the [[Pokémon in Poland|Polish]] DVD of the {{pkmn|movie}}, suggest that his name, at least in English, is Tobias.
